rows.grounds: locative of place indicating the central location
conjunction connecting or adding to the instruction
adverb referring to that specified locus
refers to the Kuṇḍalinī-power described in the preceding verses
compound characterizing her dual nature; internal sandhi nityā+anityā
instrumental indicating offerings beginning with fragrance

items.question: In what place and manner should that eternal-and-impermanent Kuṇḍalinī-power be ritually worshipped?
premises: The Kuṇḍalinī-power described earlier is the object of worship.
The prescribed locus of worship is there in the middle.
The worship is to be performed with fragrance and similar offerings.
items.inference: Therefore, one should worship that eternal-and-impermanent Kuṇḍalinī-power there in the middle with fragrance and other offerings.
uncertainties: The precise referent of 'in the middle' depends on the ritual context of the preceding passage.
The compound 'nityānityā' may characterize a dual nature or relate to the nityā cycle; the exact doctrinal nuance is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: And there, in the middle, one should worship her, who is both eternal and impermanent, with fragrance and other offerings.
